ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $ \triangle ABC \cong \triangle DEF$. If $ DF = 6$, $ AB = 3$, $ EF = 5$, and $ DC = 4$, what is the length of $ AD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\triangle ABC \cong \triangle DEF$,\\
therefore $AC = DF = 6$,\\
thus $AD = AC - DC = 6 - 4 = \boxed{2}$
